description:
List the websites the user can query in LuBot.

    Returns each site's id and name. Use this when the user asks about
    their website traffic, and to find the site_id that website_summary
    needs.

    Without sign-in it returns LuBot's public demo site (lubobali.com);
    signed in, it returns the user's own sites.
name: list_websites
title: List Connected Websites
